value.summary: This change is a documentation-only refactor of module-level comments: it rewords paragraphs about the hivemind protocol to describe a configurable "round width" instead of a single-speaker-per-step model, updates the module doc to reflect the bounded-number-of-turns design, and adds clarifying notes about serial execution. No code, types, tests, dependencies, permissions, or executable logic are touched. The diff is safe to merge.
